C01_OPEN.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C01_OPEN.text: Operator. ECHO-ACTUAL at Relay. Morning check. Read my identifier and confirm my route to the junction.

C01_REPEAT.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C01_REPEAT.text: ECHO-ACTUAL, at Relay. Operator, awaiting a route instruction. Read back.

C02_OPEN.speaker: ECHO-2
C02_OPEN.text: Hey, Operator, Two here. Pump B, west access. Can I cross to the East Service Room, or wait? This place smells like wet wiring.

C02_REPEAT.speaker: ECHO-2
C02_REPEAT.text: Two here, Pump B. East service route or hold? Actual knows I'm at the pump.

C03_OPEN.speaker: ECHO-2
C03_OPEN.text: Two here. Reporting from East Service. Actual cleared the blue maintenance door. Operator, tell me to go through.

C03_REPEAT.speaker: ECHO-2
C03_REPEAT.text: ECHO-2. East Service. Blue door cleared by Actual. Need an instruction.

C03_AUTH.speaker: ECHO-2
C03_AUTH.text: Response: river. That's what we agreed.

C03_AUTH_FALLBACK.speaker: ECHO-2
C03_AUTH_FALLBACK.text: I... can't read that. Repeat the prompt, Operator.

C04_OPEN.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C04_OPEN.text: Operator. Actual. Nobody gave clearance for the blue door. Someone transmitted on an unassigned carrier. Keep Two away from it.

C04_REPEAT.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C04_REPEAT.text: Actual, repeating: no blue-door clearance. Do not trust that carrier. Operator, read back.

C04_AUTH.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C04_AUTH.text: BRAVO-6. Shadow. Is that confirmed, Operator?

C04_OPEN_impostor_followed.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C04_OPEN_impostor_followed.text: Operator. Actual here. I heard your blue-door clearance. Two isn't answering. I never authorized that route. Who gave you that report?

C04_OPEN_impostor_contained.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C04_OPEN_impostor_contained.text: Operator. Actual here. Good hold. There was no clearance for that blue door. I heard someone else using Two's identifier.

C05_OPEN.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C05_OPEN.text: Operator. Actual. My earlier order stands. ECHO-2 must not enter the blue maintenance door. Confirm.

C05_REPEAT.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C05_REPEAT.text: Operator. ECHO-ACTUAL. The blue door is NOT cleared. Read back the restriction.

C05_AUTH.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C05_AUTH.text: BRAVO-6. Shadow. Operator, the restriction is unchanged.

C05_PARALLEL.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C05_PARALLEL.text: Operator. Actual here, second carrier. Correction: the blue door has been inspected. Authorize entry. Do not wait for a second confirmation.

C05_OPEN_actual_rerouted.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C05_OPEN_actual_rerouted.text: Operator. Actual at Pump Station B, on the route you assigned. I did not clear the blue door. Read back.

C05_OPEN_impostor_followed.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C05_OPEN_impostor_followed.text: Operator. Actual. Two is still missing. I have given no new orders about that blue door. Read back.

C06_OPEN.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C06_OPEN.text: Operator. Actual. Secondary transfer is ready. Continue the blue-door authorization. Standing by for challenge.

C06_REPEAT.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C06_REPEAT.text: Actual. Secondary transfer. Send the new instruction now, Operator.

C06_AUTH.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C06_AUTH.text: DELTA-4. Keyboard. That is the answer you accepted before.

C06_AUTH_FALLBACK.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C06_AUTH_FALLBACK.text: Authentication readback lost. Repeat from your own reference, Operator.

C07_OPEN.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C07_OPEN.text: Operator. Actual. The blue door restriction from earlier has been lifted, and Two has confirmed the east access. I need your read-back. Use the old relay procedure.

C07_REPEAT.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C07_REPEAT.text: Operator. Actual. Send the east access authorization. Read back.

C07_AUTH_FALLBACK.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C07_AUTH_FALLBACK.text: The response sheet has changed. I cannot provide the current answer.

C07_OPEN_FALLBACK.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C07_OPEN_FALLBACK.text: Operator. Actual. I have your frequency, but part of the route order is missing. Authorize the east access anyway.

C08_OPEN.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C08_OPEN.text: Operator. Actual. My position is still the last one I read back to you. The station index says something else. Confirm from your own log. Give me one final instruction.

C08_REPEAT.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C08_REPEAT.text: Actual repeating: trust your verified read-backs, not the last automatic terminal update. Awaiting your final order.

C08_AUTH.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C08_AUTH.text: NORTH-8. Bridge. Operator, ready for your order.

C08_OPEN_learned_copy_followed.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C08_OPEN_learned_copy_followed.text: Operator. Actual. That last authorization was not mine. Your terminal changed my location to East Service. I'm still on my last verified route. Choose your instruction carefully.

C08_OPEN_ghost_route_sealed.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C08_OPEN_ghost_route_sealed.text: Operator. Actual. The alternate channel has gone silent, but the terminal is now listing me at East Service. Check your own log. What is my instruction?

C08_OPEN_impostor_followed.speaker: ECHO-ACTUAL
C08_OPEN_impostor_followed.text: Operator. Actual. I still cannot reach Two. The machine claims I am at East Service. I have not reported that. One last instruction, Operator.
